name: Phishing

evidence.rationale: DNS filtering materially mitigates phishing that directs users to malicious domains. It does not mitigate phishing attachments, voice phishing, or messages that do not require visiting a domain.

9.3 helps prevent link-based and web-based initial access by stopping users from reaching malicious or unapproved content in the first place. It does this by requiring updated network-based URL filtering across all enterprise assets, using methods such as category-based filtering, reputation-based filtering, and block lists. In practice, this means enforcing controls that restrict access to unsafe websites, malicious downloads, risky scripts, and unauthorized browser extensions, reducing the risk of phishing, exploitation, and malware delivery.
DMARC may materially reduces phishing campaigns that rely on spoofed or unauthenticated sender domains.
9.6 is a preventive email-gateway control that blocks disallowed attachment types before delivery.
Email-server anti-malware directly addresses malicious attachments.
Network intrusion prevention solutions and network-based content controls can block malicious email links or attachments before they reach or execute on enterprise assets.
Application-layer filtering can block malicious websites, links, attachments, and other web or email content used in phishing activity before that content reaches users.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS results describe the ATLAS release in versions.atlas, pinned by commit and digest. ATLAS changes often: a later release can add techniques and mitigations. An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
